items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1967-02-09
items.q: Came back to America and played alto with Louis Ross's band for a year or so.

ctx.x: Like I was in your early days when you were first starting up playing. Yeah. The guys you used to listen to most. Oh. Have perhaps influenced you? Many. The guys from the Kings. Particularly Clare. Well, I tell you. When I was a kid, 14 years old in New Orleans, I used to go up on Sundays to hear Kid Orris Band. He was playing at Miss Coors Lawn. It was a penny party in those days for the kids, you know.

And I used to go up on Sundays to hear Kid Orris Band. And he was playing at Miss Coors Lawn. 10 o'clock at night. And Johnny Dodds was playing with Orris and he really amazed me. He was my idol at the time. Johnny Dodds gave me a lot of enthusiasm, you know. Enthusiasm. Yeah. Yeah. And of course you had all-fine musicians at that time. afternoons until 10 o'clock at night.
